intro: A thunder lizard horn is a hardy trophy harvested from the massive, lightning-attuned thunder lizards wandering the Barrens. Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet seeks this unusual reagent to recreate a legendary beverage originally concocted by Chen Stormstout.

p: Thunder lizards roam the arid flats of the Barrens, crackling with raw, localized lightning that arcs from their crested bodies. While hunters occasionally seek their thick hides, Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet values their horns for a very different purpose. Handed down from a mentor who learned it from the wandering pandaren Brewmaster Chen Stormstout, the recipe for Stormstout ale calls for unusual, potent local ingredients. The horn of a thunder lizard provides the electrifying kick that gives the legendary draught its fiery, unforgettable bite.
